## About ModelAG

**ModelAG** is a statistical consulting service dedicated to helping researchers, graduate students, and organizations make sense of their data. We specialize in applied statistics, quantitative ecology, and reproducible data analysis workflows.

Whether you are designing a study, analyzing complex datasets, or trying to communicate your results effectively, ModelAG provides expert guidance tailored to your specific needs.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Services We Offer

### Study Design & Planning

- Power analysis and sample size determination
- Experimental and observational study design
- Sampling strategies and survey design
- Pre-registration and open science support

### Statistical Analysis

- Generalized Linear Models (GLM) and Generalized Linear Mixed Models (GLMM)
- Generalized Additive Models (GAM/GAMM)
- Path analysis and Structural Equation Modeling (SEM)
- Multivariate statistics (ordination, clustering, discriminant analysis)
- Bayesian statistical methods
- Time series analysis
- Survival and event-history analysis

### Reproducible Research & Programming

- R programming and data wrangling
- Quarto and R Markdown document preparation
- Data visualization (ggplot2, custom figures)
- Reproducible workflow development
- Code review and optimization

### Results Interpretation & Communication

- Model output interpretation and diagnostics
- Effect size estimation and uncertainty quantification
- Scientific writing support for methods and results sections
- Preparation of publication-quality figures and tables

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Our Team

### Allen Bush-Beaupré — Founder & Lead Statistician

Allen is a research scientist at Université de Sherbrooke and Bishop's University with expertise in applied statistics and quantitative ecology. He holds an MSc and has extensive experience designing and analyzing studies across a broad range of ecological and agricultural research contexts.

**Specialties:** GLMM, Bayesian methods, path analysis, ecological statistics, R programming, reproducible research

**Affiliations:**
- Laboratoire Marc Bélisle, Université de Sherbrooke
- Laboratoire Jade Savage, Bishop's University
- Statistical consultant, Centre de Recherche en Écologie de l'Université de Sherbrooke (CREUS)

## Who We Work With

ModelAG works with:

- **Graduate students** (MSc and PhD) navigating statistical challenges in their theses
- **Academic researchers** seeking a statistical collaborator for grants, publications, or ongoing projects
- **Non-profit organizations and government agencies** requiring rigorous data analysis
- **Industry partners** in agriculture, ecology, and environmental sciences
